match.ring_count_basis.note: Native SSSR ring counts are kept; RDKit uses symmetrized rings.
match.ring_count_basis.decision: No option. RDKit's symmetrized SSSR depends on atom order; the SMARTS profiles give RDKit's ring counts where they are order-independent (profile="2026.09.1" all 310,000 cells; v1.0.38 the 2026.03.6 grid exactly), and native ring counts stay SSSR.

smirks.colon_product_bond.note: Both flag the atoms aromatic; outside a ring RDKit keeps the raw product, which fails its sanitize, and chematic drops it.
smirks.colon_product_bond.decision: No option. RDKit's raw product fails its own SanitizeMol; returning it would hand out a molecule chematic cannot write or re-read. Sanitized views agree.

smirks.fragmented_reactant.note: The RDKit adapter passes the molecule once per reactant template; chematic run_smirks with the same two reactants gives RDKit's COCO.
smirks.fragmented_reactant.decision: No option. An adapter difference: called with the same two reactants chematic gives RDKit's COCO.

smirks.hcount_query_explicit_h.note: Explicit-H reactants give the implicit-H products (#734 item 5); every RDKit product here fails its own SanitizeMol.
smirks.hcount_query_explicit_h.decision: No option. Explicit-H reactants give the implicit-H products (#734 item 5); RDKit's products here fail its own SanitizeMol.

smirks.product_h_atom_added.note: RDKit drops the added H atom and keeps CC[O-] raw; its sanitized product (CC[OH-]) is invalid, and chematic gives none.
smirks.product_h_atom_added.decision: No option. RDKit's sanitized product (CC[OH-]) is invalid; chematic gives none.

smirks.product_h_pin.note: Explicit-H reactants give the implicit-H products (#734 item 5); RDKit C[CH5] fails its own SanitizeMol.
smirks.product_h_pin.decision: No option. Implicit-H equivalence; RDKit's C[CH5] fails its own SanitizeMol.

smirks.star_on_explicit_h.note: `*` edits heavy atoms of explicit-H reactants as in the implicit form (#734 item 5); every RDKit product here fails its own SanitizeMol.
smirks.star_on_explicit_h.decision: No option. Implicit-H equivalence; every RDKit product fails its own SanitizeMol.

smirks.valence_invalid_raw.note: RDKit returns an unsanitized product that fails its own SanitizeMol; chematic returns only sanitizable products.
smirks.valence_invalid_raw.decision: No option. chematic returns only sanitizable products; run_smirks_checked reports the refused match as product_valence.
